encounters.chiefComplaint: Routine follow-up for diabetes glycemic control & cardiovascular stability

soap.subjective: Patient reports no dizziness, chest tightness, or polyuria. Compliant with prescribed oral hypoglycemic agents.
soap.objective: BP 128/82 mmHg, pulse 72 bpm regular. Heart sounds S1/S2 normal, no murmurs. Lungs vesicular breath sounds bilaterally. Lower extremities: no pedal edema.
soap.assessment: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus under fair control. Stage 1 Essential Hypertension well controlled.
soap.plan: Continue Metformin 500mg BID and Lisinopril 10mg daily. Recommend low sodium, low glycemic diet. Schedule fasting lipids & HbA1c in 3 months.

diagnosisIcd10: E11.9 - Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications

prescriptions.instructions: Take with morning and evening meals.

patients.name: Jane Trauma-Smith
patients.criticalAlert: Severe latex allergy! Use non-latex surgical equipment immediately.

encounters.chiefComplaint: Severe polytrauma following motor vehicle collision, Glasgow Coma Scale 4, unconscious

soap.subjective: Paramedics report high-speed vehicle impact. Unresponsive at scene. No family or next-of-kin present for consent.
soap.objective: GCS 4 (E1V1M2). Unequal pupils (right pupil 5mm sluggish, left 3mm reactive). Depressed skull fracture right parietal region. Tachycardic 128 bpm, hypotensive 84/52 mmHg.
soap.assessment: Acute Traumatic Brain Injury with Epidural / Subdural Hemorrhage. Hypovolemic Shock. Impending uncal herniation.
soap.plan: Urgent non-contrast CT brain. Emergency endotracheal intubation with in-line cervical stabilization. Prepare trauma operating theater for craniotomy. Cross-match 4 units O-negative packed red cells. STRICT NON-LATEX PROTOCOL.

prescriptions.instructions: Administer through dedicated line with in-line filter for cerebral edema reduction.

encounters.chiefComplaint: Routine pre-employment medical clearance and asthma check

soap.subjective: Asymptomatic. No nocturnal wheezing or shortness of breath on exertion.
soap.objective: Chest clear. Peak expiratory flow rate 520 L/min (96% of predicted).
soap.assessment: Controlled mild bronchial asthma. Medical fitness certificate issued.
soap.plan: Salbutamol inhaler PRN. Avoid NSAIDs.

prescriptions.frequency: As needed for wheezing or chest tightness
prescriptions.instructions: Use with spacer. Do not exceed 8 puffs in 24 hours.

patients.name: Priyantha Jayawardena
patients.criticalAlert: Renal dosage adjustments mandatory for all prescribed pharmaceuticals.

encounters.chiefComplaint: Nephrology assessment and renal function monitoring

soap.subjective: No gross hematuria, dysuria, or peripheral swelling noted.
soap.objective: BP 134/86 mmHg. Serum creatinine 1.7 mg/dL, eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73m2.
soap.assessment: CKD Stage 3a with stable proteinuria under ACE inhibitor therapy.
soap.plan: Maintain tight BP control < 130/80. Recheck serum electrolytes and potassium in 6 weeks.
